comment: Button -> action map for button_trigger.py. Edit + save (or rsync) and it hot-reloads in ~1s, no restart. Each action = exactly one of: play (WAV in repo), tts (built-in voice), cmd (shell). Buttons: R1/RB L1/LB R2/RT L2/LT A B X Y UP DOWN LEFT RIGHT START SELECT F1 F2.
